title: Implement pairing and bearer-token authorization
acceptance_criteria: POST /v1/pair accepts the configured pairing secret over HTTPS, creates a device, and returns the device id and bearer token exactly once.
Device tokens use cryptographically secure random bytes, are stored only as SHA-256 hashes, and are compared without exposing secrets in logs or errors.
Authorization parsing rejects missing, malformed, unknown, and revoked tokens with 401 and prevents access to another device with 403 where applicable.
Pairing enforces the two-device personal limit and tests cover successful, repeated, over-limit, invalid-secret, and revoked-token cases.
completion_summary: Implemented secure pairing, hashed random bearer tokens, strict auth ownership checks, two-device limit, safe errors, and focused tests.
